notes.title: Easy Game Creator Update
notes.content:
Easy Game Creator just got updated to a new version featuring a bunch of fixes and many improvements! Game and editor startup time has been improved and potential crashes have also been resolved with built/published HTML5 games. A rare crash was also patched that would sometimes happen while attempting to communicate with server when publishing your game after playing it.

With Valentine's Day approaching, this is a great opportunity to take advantage of these updates and give something special to your loved ones this year!

[h1]Looking for something more powerful?[/h1]
Look no further than 001 Game Creator — a powerful game creation software that does not require any coding! Like Easy Game Creator, except with MUCH greater capabilities. Recently it has received many amazing updates that brought fixes, improvements and incredible new functionalities such as support for HTTPS, native Full-Screen mode, new events as well as the latest Android Billing and API versions! Oh there's also a brand new “Tower Defense Demo” & our latest 3D Step Dungeon Maze Kit DLC!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/347400/001_Game_Creator/

And for those of you that aren't quite in the loop, we also have another ever-growing powerful game/app development software that's currently in public alpha. Feel free to participate in it here and explore hundreds of creative possibilities: [url=https://opendevkit.com/]https://opendevkit.com/[/url]


[b]Best regards,[/b]
The SoftWeir Team

notes.title: Now Free To Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42833633/5c87bba12a4f4bc1ed2709fd60efe083dcf437d5.png[/img]
Easy Game Creator early access is now FREE to play locally! We're looking for feedback and reviews to get this project rolling, so let us know what content you'd like to see.

The development of this software will heavily depend on our community's wants. We urge everyone to send us their suggestions through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/677770/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], or this [url=https://easygamecreator.com/contact/]contact form[/url] from Easy Game Creator's website.

We would love to hear about the themes, gameplay and anything else that's important to you. Feel free to include written ideas, screenshots or even gameplay prototypes! We greatly appreciate any and all feedback you have.

[h2]What happens to those who already purchased?[/h2]
Don't worry, if you purchased before this change your account will still have any game exports you purchased previously. Each purchase of Easy Game Creator came with two game exports which you still have access to.

[h2]Can free users share their games?[/h2]
No, you can create and play the games locally as many times as you want. However if you want to send your game to your friends and family via a private URL, you must either purchase the DLC or purchase from within the software.

[h2]Why free to play?[/h2]
We want as many users as possible to experience Easy Game Creator and to share wonderful experiences with their friends and family! With this new strategy we can hopefully get as many people trying the software as possible with zero commitment.

notes.title: Easy Game Creator is finally here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42833633/5c87bba12a4f4bc1ed2709fd60efe083dcf437d5.png[/img]

Easy Game Creator is a derivation of 001 Game Creator which allows anyone with a mouse and keyboard to easily create a video game to share with friends and family in minutes. Turn your friends or family into the main characters in their own video game! Simply share your game and instantly enjoy playing it on any computer, phone, or tablet.

[h3]Early Access & our future plans[/h3]
We are launching Easy Game Creator under early access in order to get a better understanding of which customization options we need to prioritize first, as current customization options are fairly limited.

Once we have a more solid idea of what direction our software is headed according to people's feedback, we'll bring more themes to cover other holidays and occasions such as weddings or Halloween, implement even more gameplays of various basic genres like puzzle, action, rpg, etc...and add tons more scenes and backdrops for existing themes and new themes to ensure you aren't limited when creating your story!

[h3]User feedback[/h3]
The development of this software will heavily depend on our community's wants. We urge everyone to send us their suggestions through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/677770/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], or this [url=https://easygamecreator.com/contact/]contact form[/url] from Easy Game Creator's website.

We would love to hear about the themes, gameplay and anything else that's important to you. Feel free to include written ideas, screenshots or even gameplay prototypes! We greatly appreciate any and all feedback you have.

[h3]What if I'm more serious about game development?[/h3]
If you're looking for something more and want a game development software that's more powerful and flexible than this, then check out 001 Game Creator. As mentioned above, Easy Game Creator is a derivation of an already existing game creation tool of ours called 001 Game Creator.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/347400/001_Game_Creator/

[h3]You have our gratitude![/h3]
Lastly, we would like to extend our big, BIG thanks to everyone who has supported us up until this point in the development of this software, as well as those who will help by participating in this early access! We are very thankful to you, and hope you get to make some amazing and unforgettable memories with your friends and family using Easy Game Creator!

For those who have been following us throughout the years, this isn't the secret upcoming project we've talked about. Our Patrons will be getting involved with that project soon, so if you wish to be included in sneak-peaks and early-access please consider supporting us on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/softweir
